summary: Command Code offers the Ox Alpha stealth model completely free: input, output and cache reads are $0 per million tokens on every plan (Go, GOAT, Pro, Max, Team Pro), drawing down neither credits nor usage limits. The deal auto-applies when you pick ox-alpha and lasts while the stealth preview ends without notice.
claim_steps: Install the CLI: npm i -g command-code, then sign in.
Have at least $1 of credits in your account to start a session.
Select Ox Alpha via /model - requests cost no credits while the stealth preview lasts.
